about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Dedication of Saint Michael the Archangel” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Relying upon the intercession of blessed Michael, Your Archangel, O Lord, we humbly pray You, that what we have received by our mouth may give grace to our mind. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
